doc.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995

title: Woods asks why the talk is about experience, not theory
summary: Woods notes the music comes from deeper than theory; Terry begins with early players 'getting off' before theory was known.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: I’d like to ask you a couple of questions. You’ve been saying some things for particularly for the students in my class I think is absolutely marvelous, incredible, because you talk about experiences not once have I heard you mention anything that’s got to do with music theory.
It seems like the music comes from some place much deeper than that. Then it eventually will involve your note choices.
